scope: Current Git-eligible UTF-8 file snapshot only; images/binaries and ignored artifacts excluded. No matching values or context are serialized. Index refresh/commit remains root-owned.

flags.contextDisposition: Instructional replacement placeholder in .env.example, not a configured token

limitations: Bounded known-prefix and assignment checks are not exhaustive proof of secret absence.
Marked synthetic fixtures must be assessed contextually; arbitrary prefixes are not exempt.
Later edits/staging/deployment require their own exact snapshot checks.
